232. Awakening (3)
"Chaos... I didn't expect you to suddenly pull out such a thing."
Jin doesn't know the identity of the bead.
But he knew better than anyone how chaos had ruined people and the world up to this point. As soon as the bead is used, the situation will undoubtedly take a turn for the worse.
"I can't die like this. I haven't yet... avenged Sakiel."
"Stop it, Paelleto. Do you think you can take revenge on me by using that bead? Not a chance. Rather, it's more likely that you'll overcome your demonization and regain your original strength."
"Hehe... you're afraid of this power."
"I'm saying this for the sake of your past. Stop your fall, Paelleto. You still have a chance."
"A chance?"
"I said I can't forgive you. Yes, you will certainly die at my hands. But not today."
"What are you babbling about, Jin Lunkandel?"

"I'm offering you a chance to make amends. Escape from your brainwashing, overcome your demonic possession, and become a true swordsman again. And contribute to Jito's death with that power. I'll spare you until then."
Jin thought Paelleto could do it.
Although he has become a monster now, he was certainly a Transcendent. He could definitely break free from the demonic possession and become a shining giant again.
If given some time, if Jin were there to help, it would definitely be possible.
Of course, even if Paelleto did, Jin would take his life once the fight with Jito was over.
Even if he played a decisive role in Jito's death, the decision was irrevocable. As mentioned earlier, the past does not absolve the present.

"Paelleto, the many tragedies happening in the human world and the demon world are all Jito's will. Your real enemy is not me, but Jito, who turned you and the demons into monsters. So, throw away that bead and accept the chance."
"Shut your damn mouth!"
Paelleto, screaming with rage, his eyes trembling slightly. Like Dialus, who briefly recalled buried memories in his last moments, he seemed to be trying to remember something.

"You must feel it too, that what I'm saying is right. That's why you couldn't use the bead right away after taking it out. Put the bead down, you can go back. Go back and avenge Sakiel, and after paying your dues, you can die."
"Shut up, shut up! All of this happened because there is no order. Yes, I can go back, if order is restored, Sakiel will return. Back, to me!"
Jin slowly approached Paelleto.

"Parielito, a good man who has committed an unforgivable sin by being used by an evil person, was such an existence. He was turned into a monster without knowing who he is or what he is doing, succumbing to an irresistible force named Jito. Just like all the devils in the demonic world, except Biseps.
"Then Sakiel can be resurrected just like you are now...!"
At the moment when there was about ten steps distance between the two.

Suddenly, a small ship appeared in the sky. It was a red owl, a space jumper of the Barmel Federation. Just now, most of the restrictions on spatial leaps and communication were lifted as Jin suppressed Parielito.
"Jin."
The one who descended from the Red Owl to the ground was Valeria. Parielito looked anxiously at her and Jin in turns.
He didn't dare to attack Valeria or take her hostage. If he moves recklessly, he will be disarmed and suppressed by Jin.
"Valeria?"
Valeria noticed Jin's change, but for now, she didn't mention it. It was certain that the fight ended with Jin's victory, and she was worried about the black bead Parielito was holding.
More than anything, the reason why she urgently searched for the battlefield was closely related to Parielito.
"...I found a strange record while investigating the castle in Groche. It's a record about Sakiel."
"A record about Sakiel?"
"Yes. I was wondering if that terrible monster, which is turning the kingdom into ruins, could continue to obey Jito after seeing this record."
Without further explanation, Valeria raised her silver birch wand and opened the record window to Parielito.
<Sakiel Groche, who was on the brink of death, heard Jito's voice.>
<Heh, hehehehe. Ah, I'm going crazy. Yes, this is it, Sakiel. This is exactly what I wanted. So you don't need to apologize to me.>
<Hahaha, you've been hard at work anyway. Don't worry about Parielito. I'll take good care of him too.>
<You're still addressing me formally. Hey, Sakiel. Don't you remember something? For example, a time in the past when you and Parielito were very close.>
<Sakiel Groche died screaming, realizing that he was Parielito's lover.>
Parielito's eyes widened.

Jin was also shocked. He had always been aware that Parielito was unusually obsessed with Sakiel. Therefore, he thought they might have been lovers, but he didn't expect Jito to play with them like this.
If it's as Valeria found in the records, Jito deliberately pushed Sakiel to death and enjoyed her despair and pain. It was the moment when what Jin had vaguely suspected turned out to be true.
"This, this is... what is... what is this record...?"

"It's exactly as you see, Paelleito. Sakiel Groshay realized just before his death that he was completely played by Zito. Zito doesn't just plunge our species into suffering. Even his subordinates like you are nothing more than toys."
Valeria's calm voice continued. Black tears were flowing from Paelleito's eyes.
"It's a lie. It's a lie, that can't be. It's a manipulated record! Ahhh...!"
His head felt like it was about to explode. If it did, the forgotten memories seemed like they would flood in.

Paelleito decided to deny that sensation. He would rather vanish as he was. He did not have the courage to face those memories. He couldn't even distinguish whether it was a brainwashed ego or his real will.
"You'd want to believe that. But unlike Zifl, our Hister never manipulates the records. Because we exist to prevent that."
"Then why would Lord Zito do this? We dedicated our loyalty to fulfill his wishes. What on earth does Zito gain by betraying us!"
"Probably, pleasure. He's an abyssal being that pursues only the pleasure of pain."
Power gathered in the silver birch staff again. With a light strike on the ground, three record windows opened in front of Paelleito.
<Sakiel, this is the only way to save you.>
<Today, I admit defeat and will become Zito's dog... I'll become a beast of the Demon World before I lose all choice.>
<Anyway, we won't remember today, like our other colleagues who were captured by Zito. Now, it's done. We can't fight anymore.>
The record windows were describing the memories that Paelleito was barely blocking now.
You can avoid the record window by closing your eyes.
But if you still want to see it, all you have to do is take out your eyes. Paelleito didn't hesitate to pierce his own eyes. There was no sensation as his fingers dug into his eyeballs.
But once the dam breaks, the memories that start flooding in cannot be ignored even if you lose your sight.
The memories were more vivid when his eyes were closed.
"Ah, ah ah ah... ah ah... ah, ah, ah, ah, ah..."
The voices of the Demon World and Paelleito were gradually mixing.
Jin saw another possibility in this scene. The possibility of him escaping brainwashing, paying for his sins, and then facing death.
"Paelleito."
Eventually, Jin knelt in front of Paelleito, who was weeping.

And bending his body, he embraced the black orb that Paelleito was holding to his chest, holding his hand. Paelleito did not resist, he just sobbed and wailed. But he didn't let go of the black orb in his hand.
He cried like that for a long time.
Jin recognized that Paelleto was escaping from Simma. A profound sadness, too deep to be concealed by brainwashing or evil charm, was turning Paelleto back into a human.
Jin did not forcibly snatch the bead. Now was not the time to provoke him.
Finally, Paelleto raised his head.

"The tragedies that have already happened to you, and to us, are irreversible. But the downfall can be stopped. Let's execute Zito together. When it's all over, I will send you to Sakiel's side. Even if you become a monster again in the process, I have the power to stop you at any time."
"Zito... together, kill him...?"
"Yes."
"Really... that's a good story... But, as you say. I committed a massacre that I shouldn't have, and you... you killed Sakiel."
"Even after escaping from Simma, do you think I'm the one who killed Sakiel?"
"Jin Runkandel, you still feel hatred for me... right?"
Jin nods his head, showing that he never had the intention of letting Paelleto live.

"I feel the same. Although it was because of brainwashing that I followed orders, it's clear that I killed people. And while it's true that Zito sent Sakiel to her death, it was definitely you who killed her. So I can't help but hate you still, even knowing it's not fundamentally your fault. Fate... is twisted and filthy."
"...I see."
"So we cannot fight together, Jin Runkandel. You may be able to, but I... I can't possibly fight with the one who killed Sakiel. Instead..."
The black bead in Paelleto's hand clenched with strength. Jin tried to pry his hand open, but Paelleto had escaped from Simma.
He shattered the bead in an instant.
"I'm going to Zito now. If I break this bead, I'll be transported to Zito's dwelling. If only I want it."
Since the bead was already shattered, Jin could no longer stop him. The spirit escaping from the bead was coloring Paelleto.

"Anyway, the brainwashing and evil charm aren't completely over. I will go mad again in a few hours. Rather, it's best for me to fight and die against Zito now, having regained some of the power and sensation of the extreme, to wound him even slightly before I die."
But Jin was sensing, watching the spirit coloring Paelleto. It wasn't something that would transport Paelleto to Zito's dwelling.
Paelleto realized it too as soon as he broke the bead, but it was already too late.
Whooooosh...!
Suddenly, Paelleto was engulfed in dark flames, and Jin sighed, gripping his sword.
A similar energy to the time when the monster was born in the sword garden from Paelleto was emanating.
"You chose to be used by someone until the end, Paelleto. You should not have broken that bead."
